if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST carry the taxable value of the supply, after taking any discount or abatement into account
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(k), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: taxable value of the supply of goods or services or both taking into account discount or abatement, if any;
